A highly educated rich boy hired right out of school. He lost his parents in a plane crash when he was young. He had been living with his younger brother until he too passed away when he was still in high school...
Severely emotionally scarred from the case 6 years ago (he was already mentally unstable, but it got worse). Supposedly, he knows something important about the HB case.

segments.text: Dislikes: The Past, Anything Kizzy Dislikes
Hobbies: Building Model Planes and Spaceships

A former thief. Until recently, he was working as a janitor but was fired due to his past... He fell in love with Kizuna Chieda after seeing her dance at Matsushita Diner. He gets rejected after confessing his love to her.
A former thief who now works as a locksmith. His feelings for Kizuna haven't changed.
He still regrets not being able to protect her 6 years ago...
Profession: Owner of Brahman World Cuisine
Likes: Harbor Warehouse District, People Who Are Unafraid of Him
He runs a restaurant called Brahman in Golden Yokocho. Since his face scares people, he usually wears a cute mask. So strong he could destroy a tank with his bare hands.
He still runs a restaurant called Brahman in Golden Yokocho. Nothing has changed. Maybe he's afraid of change.
Gen was the subject of genome experiments at Horadori Institute. He was born with a deformed face and body, and rough skin like rock.
Most appearances of "Gen" in the Present (except for Feb 13 or otherwise stated) is actually Kaname Date wearing a disguise.
A transcendental being that observes the Simulation. They perceive the story through the different protagonists of the game, and controls them to make choices as they traverse across timelines.

The Nirvana Initiative was created to trick the Frayer into traversing time between the Past and Present 4 times each as Ryuki and the two Mizukis, creating 4 Xs and allowing Tokiko to reach Enlightenment and transcend the Simulation.
Likes: Escape Games, Puzzle-Solving, Strangely-colored carbonated drinks, Pizza, Traveling
Dislikes: Alcohol, To-Do Lists, Controlled Society, Business Manners, Gantt Charts
Hobbies: Testing Ciders, Clearing Escape Games
Skills: Recreating and solving the Enigma code in her head
She was commissioned to provide engineering support for the Psync device, but recent circumstances led to her becoming the operator.
Likes: Round Things, Fluffy Things, CUTE Things, Harajuku, Chatting
Dislikes: Pollen, Natural Remedies, Internet Connection Problems,
Things that are bad for Hina
Hobbies: Collecting cutesy things, Surfing the Internet
Instantly finding Hina's location and leading her wherever she wants
A Reptilian and hostess of the Third Eye Game. She's trapped Iris, presenting the rules and progress of the game to her from behind a monitor.
In actuality, she is an AI which Hina created by copying Sakura Asahi's personality and thoughts.
Likes: Round Things, Fluffy Things, CUTE Things, Harajuku
Dislikes: Things that are bad for Hina, Pollen, Natural Remedies
Skills: Testing viruses, Instantly finding Hina's location
Sakura protected Hina from a violent assault and became bedridden, living in a state of minimal consciousness.
She fell into a coma 6 years ago, but went missing soon after.
She was taken by Hina and her consciousness was duplicated to an AI: Akemi.
Likes: Classic Cars, Curry, Bonito, Pelvises, Reika, Family
Dislikes: Soft-boiled eggs, Punk Kids, Ghosts
Skills: Reaction time increases 3.6 times under certain conditions

As a Psyncer, Date uses the Psync machine to dive into the minds of suspects of persons of interest. He lost his eye six years ago, but replaced it with a prosthetic eye which houses an advanced artificial intelligence known as an AI-Ball. He also lost all his memories past six years ago.
In No Sleep For Kaname Date – From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES:
. He's also close to Iris and Ota. One of his biggest concerns recently is how to deal with excessive sweating on his face and neck.
In AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative:
An ABIS Special Agent on a long break. He takes good care of Ryuki, both at and outside of work.
He is Mizuki's adoptive father and gets along with Iris and Ota.

He wandered all over the country after losing his memory in the explosion 6 years ago. After seeing the news of Jin's left half being found, he regained all his memories. In order to perform his own investigation, he used Gen's mask...
Date's conciousness inhabits Saito's body during the events of the first game. Once he returns to his original body, he wears a fake Saito mask during the events of the other games.
Dislikes: Dirty jokes, Going outside the simulation, Watermelon crushing VR videos, Passing "I Am Not A Robot" Tests on Websites
Hobbies: Sneaks outside of Date's eye socket while he's sleeping and makes mischief, Dancing, Watching Ants, Sympathizing With Salmon
Skills: Hacking, Fluoroscopy, Voice Imitation, 3D Modeling
An autonomous artificial intelligence called an "Al-Ball" which usually takes the shape of an eyeball.
She resides in Date's left eye socket. She assists Date by gathering information, connecting to networks and databases, and using her X-ray and thermographic functions.
In No Sleep For Kaname Date – From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES:
Recently, she has found enjoyment in chatting with Mizuki behind Date's back.
In AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative:
She got into a fight with her current partner Date and is now on her own. She is doing a top secret mission ordered by Boss.
She assists Mizuki with her investigation. Does not remember anything from the case 6 years ago.
Edited from the in-game character descriptions
Her top secret mission in AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative (Past) involves assisting Bibi in her investigations into the Half-Body Serial Killings.
Profession: Sekiba High Senior, Internet Idol
Likes: Singing, Dancing, The Occult, Irises, Mizuki, Friends
Hobbies: Singing, Dancing, Let's Plays/Game Commentary

Iris is an internet idol (musician) belonging to the entertainment office Lemniscate. Her stage name is "A-set," but her fans call her "Tesa" ("Aseton" in Japanese). She is Hitomi's daughter and good friends with Mizuki, Kizuna, Amame, Ota, and many others.
Edited from the in-game character descriptions across all games
She's the illegitimate daughter of So Sejima and Manaka Iwai, taken in by Hitomi following her birth and Manaka's death.
Like: Tonkotsu Ramen, Stew, Monja, Unagi/Eel, Metal Pipes, Iris
Dislikes: Raw seafood, Perverts, How Date holds chopsticks
Hobbies: Breeding Clione, Collecting Adorabbit merch
Skills: Studies martial arts and enjoys emotionally attacking Date

Mizuki is Renju Okiura and Shoko Nadami's daughter. Mizuki is quite mature for her age and can have a sharp attitude at times. Although she is not related to Date, he became her de facto guardian four years ago. The two have lived under one roof ever since.
In No Sleep For Kaname Date – From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES and AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative (Past):
Her father and mother, Renju Okiura and Shoko Nadami, have passed away. She has been adopted by Kaname Date and uses his last name.
She sometimes assists Date when he needs the extra muscle power. Gets along well with Iris, Amame, and Kizuna.
Edited from the in-game character descriptions
Profession: Light Novel Author (Self-Declared), Cook at Matsushita Diner (AINS-AINI)
Skills: Cooking (incl. omelet rice), Driving, Sockpuppeting
Ota is Mayumi's son. An enthusiastic follower of A-set, he often pushes the boundary between idols and fans. He writes his own light novels and gets editing advice from his friend Mizuki.
In No Sleep For Kaname Date – From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES and AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative (Past):

Though unemployed until recently, he inherited and took charge of Matsushita Diner. After finding out Tesa likes the occult, he brushed up his knowledge on the subject. He's also close to Mizuki, Kizuna, and Amame.
Likes: Wine, Gourd dolls, Anything Shiny or Black
Dislikes: Happy families, Ex-boyfriends, MPD's Director, Decluttering and organizing
Hobbies: Going to clubs in Kabukicho
Skills: Grasping people's weaknesses, applying pressure, and making them obey
In AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES and No Sleep For Kaname Date – From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES:
The ABIS Commander. Date's direct superior and long-time friend. She appears to be an easygoing optimist with a carefree attitude, but she is as cunning as a fox with a quick wit.
In AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative:
Ryuki's direct superior and Date's old friend. Her mood changes on a daily basis. She gives off a carefree vibe, but she's as cunning as a fox.
Edited from the in-game character descriptions
Likes: Multiples of 16, Chairs, Tokoroten, Amore
Hobbies: Working with machines, Collecting doujins, Imitating Magical girls
Pewter is ABIS’s engineer and a brilliant mechanic. Currently, he is responsible for maintaining the Psync machine and preparing Psyncs. He also invented Aiba (and set her personality to his liking).
In No Sleep For Kaname Date – From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES:
An ABIS engineer, mechanic, and all around a capable scientist. Though he was in charge of managing and optimizing the Psync machine, a crime he committed got him discharged and taken into detention.
In AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative:
An ABIS engineer and mechanic. His main job is operating and maintaining the Psync machine.
He committed a crime in the past leading to his dismissal, but Boss pulled some strings to get his job back.
He created the AI-Balls (Aiba and Tama). He got his clothes off eHarbor.
In AI, Pewter is Renju's lover, the one who gave him the watch as an anniversary gift. In AINS, he is hidden inside a medical pod and is given the monicker Person of Interest I to hide his identity.
Profession: Entertainment Company and Maid Café.

Renju Okiura is A-set's producer. He manages the entertainment office Lemniscate and the maid cafe Sunfish Pocket. He is the ex-husband of Shoko Nadami and Mizuki's father. He has been Date's close friend for 5 years.
(in AI and AINI Past) | 43 (in AINI Present)
Likes: Children, Okonomiyaki, Best Friends, Iris, Mizuki.
Dislikes: Antisocial people, War, Sickness, Organized Crime (AINS).
Hobbies: Reading, Gardening, Watching zombie movies.
Skills: Playing the video game involving shooting down alien invaders.
Hitomi is Iris's unmarried mother and an elementary school teacher. Her parents died in an accident when she was 17. She raised Iris alone. Due to an injury in the past, she can't move her right arm.
Age: 36 (in AI and AINI Past) | 42 (in AINI Present)
Profession: Tending bar, Selling information; Fortuneteller (AINI)
Likes: Loincloths; Switching, Making them touch (AI); Bali Riva, Sword Fighting
Dislikes: Hate crimes, Customers who throw up in the bar
Hobbies: Polishing bonito, Watching videos (AI); Shining Her Crystal Ball(s), Watching Hiraoka's Promotional Video
Skills: Has the uncanny ability to detect virginity (AI); Fortune-Telling, Guessing How "Big" a Guy Is
Mama is the owner of the bar "Marble" in Golden Yokocho in Shinjuku. Date and Renju are regulars there and she knows them well. She is also an information broker in the criminal underworld.
In AI: The Somnium Files - nirvanA Initiative:
The owner of the bar named Marble in Golden Yokocho. She knows a lot of information, even criminal or darker facts. Recently picked up fortunetelling and has received some praise for her accuracy.

Over the past 6 years, her fortunetelling accuracy has increased. A few years ago, she had lines out the door, but it got to be too much for her and she banned everyone but repeat customers. Mama's amazing...
Likes: Humanity and justice, Chivalry, Gandhi, Pandas, Women, Puff-Puff, A-set
Hobbies: Watching dance/A-set Videos, Collecting art, Hot springs vacation, Collecting A-set Merch

Moma is the leader of the Kumakura yakuza gang, after his predecessor stepped down years ago. In the past, the Kumakura were known for being ruthless and violent, but Moma hopes to make the group more peaceful and business-minded.
In No Sleep For Kaname Date – From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES and AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative (Past):

The eccentric leader of a yakuza group that's hardly yakuza-like, trying to clean up their act. He maintains connections to the criminal underworld and it's not uncommon for him to have information that even the police do not.
In AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative (Present):
Even after 6 years, Moma still runs the Kumakuras, trying to keep a clean slate. I've never seen anyone actually working there. Are they really still active?!
Age: 24 (in AI and AINI Past) | 30 (in AINI Present)
Likes: Ass, Erotic Novels, His boss
Dislikes: Police, His big brother, Animal cruelty
Skills: Won a dog-training contest (AI); Squinting Really Hard to See Through the Censorship
He is the lowest ranking member of the Kumakuras. He once had dreams of pursuing the top spot in the gang, but has since decided that he would rather focus on training his favorite dog.
In AI: The Somnium Files - nirvanA Initiative (Past):
He was once a Kumakura, but recently left the group. When Jin Furue's body was found at Studio Dvaita, he was sitting in the contestant seat with Moma.
(AI); Iomante, The Sound of Civilization, Old Man Shamo (AINI)

Dokuta Yogano is a member of the Kumakura Family, having first worked under Rohan Kumakura, and later Moma Kumakura. Perhaps due to the way he looks, he is often mistaken for a low-ranking member even though he is toward the top. He typically does office work. He has recently fallen in love and lost a lot of weight.
In AI: The Somnium Files - nirvanA Initiative (Present):
Kumakura member. He isn't taking the divorce well... He says weird things, but that's supposedly caused by watching the Nirvana Trial video.
Edited from the in-game character descriptions

Dokuta works as the resident mob doctor for the Kumakuras; his name is a pun on 闇のドクター (underground doctor). He's acquainted with Renju Okiura and Hitomi Sagan, even helping give birth to Iris Sagan and patching an injured Falco in the past. In the first game, he gained a fiancee, the nurse Hanayo Nasu from Central Hospital. In the second game (Present), he and Nasu are divorced.
Age: 30 (in AI and AINI Past) | 36 (AINI Present)
Profession: An officer working for the CSI unit of the MPD.
Likes: Earpicks, Dandelions, Afros; Kesaran Pasaran (AI and AINI Past); Angel Hair (AINI Present)
Dislikes: People who don't remember his name, Cilantro, Ginkgo
An expert investigator with remarkable skills. He's the lead inspector for the Cyclops Serial Killings. He's actually really cute when he takes his mask off, and he's single...
In AI: The Somnium Files - nirvanA Initiative:
A talented inspector. He was assigned to the case by Police HQ due to his impressive skills.
Supposedly, he's really handsome under the mask.
He's looking for a girlfriend, but addicted to dating apps.
Age: 36 (in AI and AINI Past) | 42 (in AINI Present)
Dislikes: Men that act like ballers but are really scrubs (AI and AINI Past) | Presidents Who Don't Raise Her Salary (AINI Present)
Hobbies: Gambling, Partying (AI) | Slots Are The Way To Go, Baby! (AINI Past) | Sitting On the Reception Desk Naked, Sometimes (AINI Present)
She is Lemniscate's receptionist. She likes men that are real bros and can vibe with them from the jump. Lately, her shoulders have been stiffening up on her, though.
In AI: The Somnium Files - nirvanA Initiative:
She LOVES a man with a deep, gravely voice, y'know? She's totally in love with that shiz. Kinda has an upset stomach lately, which sucks.
She got dumped recently so she's been suuuper sad. It's like trying to beat an impossible game and it's just game over instantly, it sucks. She's super sad feel bad for her plz.
Profession: Sekiba High Senior, Maid Cafe Maid
Likes: Ratatat, bang bang, and slappy slap (in AI); Quizzes, The Occult, Dance, Music, Voices, Right (Side) (in AINI)
Dislikes: Sea Kings who stay for an hour after ordering just one cup of coffee, Silence, Left (Side)
Skills: Exploiting the vanity of her customers to make huge sums of money, Receiving Lavish Gifts
She works as a maid at Sunfish Pocket. She's friends with Iris, Mizuki, and Ota, and occasionally goes on haunted tours and UFO sightings with them.
In AI: The Somnium Files - nirvanA Initiative (Past):

A "Mermaid" at Sunfish Pocket. Wanting to work the late shift, she lied and said that she was 20 years old. She's in the school dance club with Iris and Kizuna. A regular at Brahman and close with Gen.
